question: How late will train IC 542 (scheduled 20:58 CET) arrive at Brussels-Central on 2026-11-06?
outcomes: Less than 15 min (on time or early)

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Less than 15 min (on time or early)": Wins if train IC 542 arrives at Brussels-Central on 2026-11-06 fewer than 15 minutes after its scheduled arrival time of 20:58 CET (i.e., actual arrival is at or before 21:12:59 CET), or arrives early.
- "15–29 min": Wins if train IC 542 arrives at Brussels-Central on 2026-11-06 between 15 and 29 minutes (inclusive) after its scheduled arrival time of 20:58 CET (i.e., actual arrival between 21:13 and 21:27:59 CET).
- "30–44 min": Wins if train IC 542 arrives at Brussels-Central on 2026-11-06 between 30 and 44 minutes (inclusive) after its scheduled arrival time of 20:58 CET (i.e., actual arrival between 21:28 and 21:42:59 CET).
- "45–59 min": Wins if train IC 542 arrives at Brussels-Central on 2026-11-06 between 45 and 59 minutes (inclusive) after its scheduled arrival time of 20:58 CET (i.e., actual arrival between 21:43 and 21:57:59 CET).
- "60 min or more": Wins if train IC 542 arrives at Brussels-Central on 2026-11-06 60 or more minutes after its scheduled arrival time of 20:58 CET (i.e., actual arrival at 22:58 CET or later), or if the train is cancelled and does not serve Brussels-Central at all on that date.

Clarifications:
- Delay is measured as the difference in whole minutes between the actual arrival time of IC 542 at Brussels-Central and the scheduled arrival time of 20:58 CET on 2026-11-06, as recorded in real-time SNCB/NMBS train tracking data.
- If the train is cancelled or does not reach Brussels-Central, it is treated as arriving with a delay of 60 minutes or more.
